extracted: As summarized: nicotine dependence is the exception to the pattern of no gender difference, with worse outcomes in women; nicotine replacement worked better in men in a large randomized study; varenicline worked better in women in one meta-analysis and, in another of 32 trials (14,389 people, 51% women), as well in both sexes against placebo but with greater benefit for women relative to nicotine patch and bupropion; with naltrexone for smoking, men reduced smoking more and women gained less weight.
